snippet.title: The Dead Await | 1.0 Launch Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
The Dead Await is OUT NOW on Steam
Survive the outbreak or become part of it ➤ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393580/The_Dead_Await/

Fight through the zombie apocalypse in this brutal deck-building RPG where every choice could be your last. Build powerful card synergies, scavenge for survival, and uncover the truth behind the collapse of civilization.

Play The Dead Await 1.0 now on Steam.
Visit indie.io on Steam ➤ https://bit.ly/4e91q5q
